Agentes de IA no trabalho: comece por um: AI agents at work: start with a specific problem — Calembe dos Santos
Em vez de começar por um agente que “res: Instead of starting with an agent that “answers everything,” choose a problem you can evaluate: finding internal procedures, routing support requests, or helping a team look up information. Define who will use it and the outcome you expect.
O Microsoft Copilot Studio permite criar: Microsoft Copilot Studio lets you build agents and workflows, connect knowledge sources, and add tools. The official documentation covers building, testing, publishing, and monitoring.
Um agente precisa de fontes adequadas e: An agent needs relevant, up-to-date sources. Identify the reference documents, their owners, and who is allowed to access them. Plan authentication and data policies before making the agent available.
A governação do Copilot Studio inclui co: Copilot Studio governance includes controls over access and data use. Review the connections and actions allowed for the use case. An agent that answers questions and one that changes records require different decisions.
Crie perguntas reais, incluindo pergunta: Create real-world questions, including some that the sources cannot answer.
Verifique se o agente reconhece limites: Check that the agent recognizes its limits and refers users to a person when needed.
Teste com utilizadores que tenham permis: Test with users who have different permissions.
Para acções com impacto, planeie uma con: For consequential actions, plan for human confirmation before execution.
Recolha feedback e atribua um responsáve: Collect feedback and assign someone to maintain the agent.
Este é um exemplo de abordagem a um proj: This is an example of a project approach, not a promise of automatic results. The agent’s usefulness depends on the problem, the sources, and the controls you define.

Esqueceu a palavra-passe da BIOS? Saiba: Forgot your BIOS password? Here’s how to request recovery — Calembe dos Santos
A palavra-passe da BIOS ou UEFI é difere: A BIOS or UEFI password is different from your Windows sign-in password. It may protect startup, device settings, or, in some cases, the storage drive. Note the message shown and identify the make and model.
Não existe um procedimento único que fun: There is no single procedure that works on every computer. Dell, for example, directs users to contact support and may request the model, Service Tag, and proof of ownership for recovery. For other brands, consult the relevant official support service.
Tenha à mão o modelo e o número de série: Have the model and serial number ready.
Reúna a factura ou outro comprovativo de: Gather the invoice or another proof of ownership.
Num equipamento da empresa, contacte pri: For a company device, contact the IT department first.
Descreva a mensagem exacta e as tentativ: Describe the exact message and the steps you have already tried.
O PDF original sugeria provocar um bloqu: The original PDF suggested triggering a lock and using a code generator as a solution for any computer. This version replaces that claim with manufacturer-specific guidance. Do not enter random passwords repeatedly or follow instructions for a different model: the procedure depends on the device and the type of protection.
Se também aparecer um pedido de chave de: If you also see a BitLocker recovery key prompt, treat it as a separate request. Tell support about both messages to avoid confusing firmware recovery with access to your data.
Migrar e-mail para Microsoft 365: o que: Migrating email to Microsoft 365: what to prepare before the move — Calembe dos Santos
Quando a mudança é entre tenants: When the move is between tenants
Prepare um piloto e a transição: Prepare a pilot and the transition
Migrar de um servidor externo para Micro: Migrating from an external server to Microsoft 365 and migrating between two tenants are different scenarios. Start by identifying the source system, mailbox count, data volume, domains, and dependencies. Choose the method based on that assessment.
Na migração por IMAP, são transferidas m: IMAP migration transfers messages from mail folders; contacts, calendars, and tasks need to be handled separately. Destination mailboxes must be prepared before migration. Moving email is not the same as migrating the entire work environment.
Uma migração nativa de caixas entre tena: Native cross-tenant mailbox migration requires configuration in both environments and has specific identity and licensing requirements. Microsoft documents a per-user migration license for this scenario. Confirm the current requirements before finalizing the budget.
O projecto deve ainda definir o tratamen: The project must also address domains, addresses, permissions, and applications. OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams need their own planning: moving a mailbox does not move all of these services.
registe caixas, aliases, grupos, calendá: record mailboxes, aliases, groups, shared calendars, and devices that send email.
teste um grupo representativo e document: test a representative group and document failures and timings.
explique quando ocorre a mudança e como: explain when the change will happen and how to get help.
confirme envio, recepção, acesso ao hist: confirm sending, receiving, access to historical messages, and email client configuration.
defina critérios de aceitação e um plano: define acceptance criteria and a plan for handling issues.
Evite prometer uma transição sem interru: Avoid promising a disruption-free transition before assessing the environment. The goal is to anticipate dependencies and reduce the impact on the team.

Uma revisão simples com a equipa: A simple review with the team
Uma palavra-passe forte é apenas uma par: A strong password is only one part of protection. In Microsoft Entra, security defaults help establish a baseline, including multifactor authentication and blocking legacy authentication. Before changing policies, check how your team and applications sign in to services.
Organizações com necessidades específica: Organizations with specific needs can use Conditional Access, subject to the applicable licensing. The choice should account for users, devices, and applications. Avoid replacing an existing protection without preparing and testing the alternative.
Para acessos sensíveis, avalie métodos r: For sensitive access, evaluate phishing-resistant methods. Microsoft distinguishes these methods from MFA options that can still be bypassed through phishing attacks.
Identifique quem tem funções administrat: Identify who has administrative roles and whether they still need them.
Confirme os métodos de autenticação regi: Review registered authentication methods and the account recovery process.
Peça à equipa para comunicar pedidos de: Ask the team to report unexpected authentication requests.
Defina quem deve ser contactado quando u: Define who should be contacted when an account appears compromised.
Estas perguntas ajudam a preparar uma re: These questions help prepare an environment review. Changes should be tested to avoid locking users out or disrupting applications.
